sub_indicators.text: National strategy for development of statistics: statistics strategy
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Charter on Statistics and the Strategy for the Harmonisation of Statistics in Africa (SHaSA 2) ask each country to design, carry out and evaluate a national strategy for the development of statistics.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country has no current statistics strategy and none in preparation.
A national statistics strategy is being designed, drafted, validated or put to cabinet, or one adopted in the past three years has run out. A strategy only promised does not count.
An adopted strategy is current: its stated period covers today. One with no stated period counts for five years.
Progress on the current strategy has been reviewed in the past three years: an annual review, a progress report or a meeting of its steering body.
A mid-term or final evaluation of the current strategy, or the final evaluation of the one it replaced, has been completed in the past three years.
